[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended a simple recipe for Japanese-style short-grain sushi rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Sushi Rice Recipe:  
- Ingredients: 1 cup Japanese short-grain rice, 1 3/4 cups water, 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1 teaspoon salt.  
- Instructions: Rinse rice, soak for 30 minutes, cook with water, let cool, mix vinegar, sugar, and salt, fold into rice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested using high-quality Japanese rice vinegar for seasoning sushi rice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended a general guideline for seasoning: 1 part rice vinegar to 1 part sugar and 1 part salt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advised to add the vinegar mixture to the rice when it's still slightly warm.

- Spicy Mayo: 1 tablespoon hot sauce with 2 tablespoons mayonnaise.  
- Korean Chili Flakes (Gochugaru): Sprinkle over sushi for heat.
